elements.content:
Gina: You look really tired. What’s the matter with

you?

Evan: I have a headache.

Gina: I’m sorry to hear that. What caused it?

Evan: I stayed up late for a school project.

Gina: Staying up late is bad for your health. It’s

important to get enough sleep.

Evan: I know, but I want to finish it on time.

Gina: You should go to bed earlier tonight and you’ll

feel better tomorrow.

Evan: I will. Thanks for your concern.

elements.content:

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.
